notes: Fix for the anywhere handle: swiping in from the edge was being claimed by Android's Back gesture, so only a swipe up along the edge opened the pie. The handle now formally claims its strip of the edge from gesture navigation (and releases it while the pie is open, so Back still escapes). Also: tapping the handle now parks the pie instead of blinking it, and if a gesture is interrupted mid-grab the pie stays up parked rather than retracting.
